decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (001, 002 - Received 10/12/12
003 rev.B , 004 rev.C - Received 6/2/13
005 rev.A-  Received 5/2/13  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Within one planting season of the removal of the Apple tree, a replacement Apple tree should be replanted within the rear garden of number 92 Princes Avenue. The tree should be a minimum of 1.0m tall at the time of planting. The replacement tree shall be maintained in perpetuity. Should a replacement tree die or become seriously damaged or moribund, then a further replacement tree to the same specification shall be planted immediately.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and erection of a single storey extension to the existing garage to the house
